title: a-proofs-isolation-holds-however-it-is-invoked
intention: A proof's isolation holds however it is invoked: no proof run by a CC tool call or by codemother's verdict writes into live ~/.cairn.
why: Measured 2026-10-06: 88 of 290 proofs write live ~/.cairn when run outside the tester's seal (2705 paths), a CC session's hand run leaked 6 inference tickets, and codemother's verdict runs proofs bare at every PROVED. The lived symptom: the operator's live logs, trouble lanes and launcher pid files carry fixture writes nobody can tell from real ones. The seal is the single door; the hands that bypass it are refused or routed through it.
traces_to: Law 8 and Law 4: the seal is the one door, held by physics. the strace census harness (scratchpad census_pytest_writes.py, 2026-10-06: 88 of 290 proofs wrote 2705 paths into live ~/.cairn under raw pytest; one CC session's python3 run of e9a2's proof leaked 6 inference tickets).
how: Children: 1af0564c0db3 (bin: rewrite python3 proof runs under the seal and refuse pytest at PreToolUse), 2c9eeab2da87 (tester: publish a sealed exec), 68cef2ddd8ef (codemother verdict: run instruments through it). No conftest: nothing in the repo uses pytest (cairn/devices/tester/cli.py line 9), and CC's pytest hand is 1af0564c0db3's.

clauses.claim: every per-proof command of the census harness typed as a CC Bash command is refused (pytest) or rewritten to run under the seal (python3), never run bare (discharged: 1af0564c0db3 PROVED)
the census harness re-run through `cairn test --exec` over the censused proofs records 0 writes into live ~/.cairn (discharged: 2c9eeab2da87 PROVED)
a verdict run of a chart instrument executes sealed (discharged: 68cef2ddd8ef PROVED)

for a fixture proof that writes under $HOME/.cairn, each spelling bin/cmd/proofgate's segment judgement does not see (`ls <proof> | xargs python3`, a heredoc fed to bash that runs `python3 <proof>`, a script file that runs it) is judged by the gate exactly as the hook would, what the gate hands back is run under a scratch HOME, and every spelling records 0 writes under that HOME's .cairn; any nonzero is a measured hole that reopens 72a37498c601's WRONG INTENT clause

decisions.text: D1: a census proof types the three spellings over a fixture proof through proofgate.judge, runs what it hands back under a scratch HOME (CAIRN_HOME_HOST and CAIRN_BUS_* dropped), and asserts 0 writes per spelling.
D2: proofgate judges the command xargs runs (xargs joins the prefix commands, its own options skipped), so `... | xargs python3 <proof>` is rewritten.
D3: the script-file spelling is sealed by the physics open-49fc67a40ede names.

measured.saw: fixture proof writing $HOME/.cairn/leak/<spelling>: xargs gate=pass writes ['xargs']; heredoc gate=rewrite writes []; script gate=pass writes ['script']
measured.how: scratchpad census.py on akienasus: proofgate.judge per spelling, the returned command run by bash under a scratch HOME
